title: cmux community registry entries
description: extensions.json, themes.json, snippets.json and setups.json: each is an array of entries. One entry lists one repository (or one directory of it).

id.description: OWNER/NAME, lowercased, starting with the repository owner. For an extension it equals the manifest id.

repo.description: OWNER/REPO on GitHub, or https://HOST/OWNER/REPO on another git host.

path.description: Directory inside the repo holding the item's manifest (cmux-app.v2.json) or marker file (cmux-theme.json, cmux-snippet.json, cmux-setup.json). Omit for the repo root.
